top_level.form_sets: object mapping stable setID to array of Form
top_level.fallback_entries: array of explicitly labelled diagnostic generic word Face IDs; not production authority
top_level.provenance: exact input hashes and record proof files

Face.reading: string or null; non-Roman target requires nonempty
Face.qualification: existing_assessed_frame_face|existing_reviewed_word_face|new_experimental_compound_face; none alone implies broader typed-context acceptance

Form.features: array of exact retained tags, no invented POS certainty
Form.face_ids: target language→Face ID map; may be empty for context-only morphology

Pattern.approved_outputs: array of Output; empty for recognized-but-unavailable/ambiguous whole idiom
Pattern.meaning_id: stable intended sense; competing matched IDs on same atomic context trigger ambiguity withholding
Pattern.priority: integer; higher is more specific only after context-length comparison

Part.common: name is unique within pattern; every part including literal has one

typed.name: string
typed.max_words: positive int≤3 forpossessor; native-word budget does not permit partial capture

morph.name: string
morph.form_set: existing set ID; complete attested surfaces only

focus.name: string
focus.form_set: existing set ID; complete attested source output forms

RangeSpec.through: named final part ifkind=parts; inclusive end. Ranges are exact consumed UTF16 scopes, never target offsets.

Output.face_ids: explicit target→Face ID map used only whenface_from_part=null
Output.concept_id: explicit approved output concept; must match selectedFace
Output.native_cost: computed from complete native source tokens at runtime, not literal training count

case_wrapper.cases: array of {id,text,source_language,target_languages,stratum,family_hint,expected_scope_category}; authored expectations are diagnostics not independent correctness

typed_grammar.possessor: my/your/his/her/its/our/their OR1–3letter/mark name-shaped tokens ending apostrophe-s (ASCII orcurly), OR final-s plus possessive apostrophe. Internal apostrophes/hyphens permitted; nested possessive endings in earlier tokens rejected. No claim of actual person/NER identity. Exact captured text retained.
typed_grammar.number: ASCII digits with optional leading+ and spaces/dashes/parentheses/decimalpoint, at leastone digit; no linebreak. Source values preserved, no number normalization. Count agreement only where explicit pattern constraint is supplied; no inferred agreement.
typed_grammar.identifier: A complete existing protected URL/handle/code range; capture can be in context but output cannot overlap. Plain names use possessor grammar, no target insertion.
typed_grammar.matching: Literal/enum/morph/focus case variants must be explicitly supplied; no silent casefold matching. Native wholecontext windows bound parsing. Typed alternatives must end at complete source word/literal boundaries, not prefixes.

recognition_trace.retention: Keep independently of selectedoutputs and even when known/overbudget/no-target; ambiguity masks precede smaller-backoff.

output_storage: Stream one JSONL record per input source with contexts/recognitions once and nested target/arm/density/known decisions. TRAIN may aggregate wholly unmatched rows while retaining exactIDs+counts; retain all matched/rejected/protected scopes. Bound native output20MiB, reportincomplete ifexceeded. No repeated entire inputpercombination.
